tei:div.tei:p: 1) ༄༅/ oṃ swa sti/ ḍā ki kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo'i zab gter chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig gi glegs bam phyi ma/ ya)rtags can 'dir/ mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs sprin dpung dang*/ de'i bsnyen dmigs/ mchod bstod bcas ldeb/ bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mchod spros med rgyun khyer ldeb/ phung po mchod sbyin tshogs gnyis chu gter ldeb/ bde ba'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya bsdus pa byin rlabs dpal ster ldeb/ dag snang las rig 'dzin bla ma'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs gter mdzod ldeb/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor na mo rgyal ba kun yum sogs ldeb/ sku gsum ḍā ki'i gsol 'debs dngos grub bang mdzod ldeb/ yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor rang mdun gyi sogs ldeb/ bla ma mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs bum bzang ldeb/ zab gter 2)chos sgo 'byed pa'i gsol 'debs thugs dam gnad bskul ldeb/ nor lha'i sgrub thabs dngos grub bum bzang ldeb/ dam rdzas dug bsgyur phrin las myur mgyogs spu gri'i 'khor lo zab pa'i rgya can ldeb/ srung ma'i gsol mchod bsdus pa ldeb/ e ma ho rgyal ba'i yum mchog sogs gsol 'debs ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ nyams snang skor la/ lhag pa'i lha la gsol 'debs thugs brgyud gnad bskul gyis thog drangs/ gsol 'debs nang gses zhe bdun la ldeb/ 'og min mkha' spyod zhing du skye ba'i smon lam dri med nor bu dang*/ g.yu lo bkod du skye ba'i smon lam phan bde'i myu gu bcas ldeb/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsol 'debs thugs rje'i myu gu ldeb/ skye 'phreng gsol 'debs bsdus pa byin rlabs sprin phung ldeb/ ku su lu'i nyams byung gnas tshul mdor bsdus rdo rje'i spun gyis dris lan 3) mos pa'i lam bzang ldeb/ don dam bla ma'i ngo sprod dang*/ gter ston gyi gzungs ma'i rnam dbye bcas ldeb/ zhal gdams bslab bya'i rim pa nang gses le tshan nyer gsum la ldeb/

bskal pa shing bya lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgu sogs gsang ba'i rnam thar gyi thog drangs/ dus 'dzin me stag ces pa'i bar nang gses dgu la ldeb/ las ldan bu slob rnams la springs pa'i zhal gdams snying po'i don bsdus gsal ba'i me long ldeb/ a nu yo ga'i dmigs rim bsdus pa ldeb/ bskyed rdzogs gtum mo'i gegs sel 'od gsal spyi don bsdus pa ldeb/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rgyal sras sogs thabs grogs dpa' bor phul ba'i snying gtam nang gses gnyis la ldeb/ zhal gdams rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa mthong ba don ldan sna tshogs 4) rang grol nang gses so drug la ldeb/ klong chen rab 'byams sogs zhal gdams nang gses bzhi la ldeb/ kye ma rgyal kun 'dus zhal sogs bla ma'i thugs brgyud bskul ba'i gsol 'debs ldeb/ dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus zhal sogs thabs grogs bla ma dran pa'i gdung dbyangs dang*/ zhal gdams bcas nang gses bcu drug la ldeb/ pha rdo rje 'chang dbang sogs zhal gdams nang gses bcu bdun la ldeb/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs sogs zhal gdams gsung mgur nang gses brgyad la ldeb/ dbang gi rnam bshad ldeb/ mchog sprul don 'grub rdo rje la zhu yig tu phul ba blun gtam rig pa'i 'dra 'bag ldeb/ gdod nas rnam dag sogs zhal gdams dang*/ thun dung rnam grangs/ springs yig sogs nang gses drug la ldeb/ sems med sprang mo'i rmongs glu dang*/ rang la rang gis gros 'debs zhal gdams sogs nang gses bcu bzhi la ldeb/ 5)rmi lam rang grol gyi gdams pa gsal ba'i sgron me ldeb/ rmi khrid kyi sa bcad ldeb/ dbyings mi 'gyur nam mkha'i sogs dus bzang mchod pa'i skabs kyi tshogs glu dang*/ nyams snang lung bstan sna tshogs/ rta mgrin mngon rtogs bcas nang gses bcu gcig la ldeb/ rtsa gsum gtor ma'i dpe'u ris dngos grub 'byung gnas skal ldan gsar pa'i me long ldeb/

las bzhi'i sbyin srig gi dkyil 'khor dpe ris ldeb/ phur sgrub kyi 'don 'grigs theg chen lam 'jug ldeb/ sku phreng gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbyig thob ldeb/ skye phreng gsol 'debs thugs rje'i lcags kyu ldeb/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi dbang sgrub skabs kyi gsal byed zin bris ldeb/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs kyi mtshams lugs las 'grigs bsdus pa gsal bar bkod pa ldeb/ zab gter dbang gi 'don 'grigs gsal ba'i me long skal 6)bzang 'jug ngogs ldeb/ rdor gsor dang*/ skyu gu'i lag len zur byang ldeb/ phag mo'i nang sgrub dang 'brel bar sbyin sreg gi spros med rnal 'byor zin bris ldeb/ rig 'dus/ rta mgrin/ phur pa sogs kyi zin bris mdor bsdus ldeb/ bcas le tshan nyis brgya dgu bcu dang*/ glegs bam gyi dkar chag rang nyid ldeb/ bcas bsdoms ldeb grangs/ bzhugs/ mtshungs med ḍā ki bde skyong dbang mo yi// zab gter mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chos sde'i gzhung*// rig 'dzin dbang mos spar du btab spel mthus// zab chos phrin las mi nub mthar rgyas shog ༈ /grub brnyes rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i 'khor los sgyur// sngon med gdams zab mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdag /mkha' spyod dbang mo bde ba'i rdo rje yi// ring lugs phyogs mthar 'phel rgyas rtag khyab shog
